rule.name: Logistic Extremization (k = 1.15)
rule.summary: Transforms each market probability p into log-odds, multiplies by k = 1.15, and maps back through the logistic sigmoid (clamped to [1%, 99%]). Backtest prices are sampled 7 days before market close/resolution.
